The built-in consensus client is on by default. Pass --externalcl to keep an external consensus client.
In 3.0.0, Polygon checkpoint sync is on unless you set --polygon.sync=false. From 3.7.0 that flag is rejected, so do not add it when the target is 3.7 or newer.

Remove this flag. Polygon chain names and --bor.* / --polygon.* flags are no longer accepted. Use https://github.com/0xPolygon/erigon.
A new datadir now keeps receipts. Pass --prune.include-receipts=false when creating it to keep the old disk-saving default. An existing datadir keeps the setting it was created with.
Custom graffiti is prefixed with client identification unless you set --beacon.api.preserve-graffiti. The prefix leaves 19 bytes, or 25 while the execution-client version is unavailable.

QUIC listens on UDP 4001 unless you set --caplin.discovery.quicport. If --caplin.discovery.port is already 4001, pick a different QUIC port or Caplin will not start. Standalone Sentinel uses --sentinel.quic.port.
